newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on technical correction.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways to end down on Monday on a technical correction and dealers said the index at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) would dip below the 1,900-point mark in the near term.
"The index had risen sharply last month and this correction was due," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "The selling pressure is likely to continue as people are in an overbought position."
The KSE's 100-share index fell 32.75 points, or 1.69 percent, to end at 1,900.51. Losers led gainers 204 to 53. Hub Power fell 0.40 to 54.85 rupees and Shell Pakistan 4.0 to 295.
